svg.aria-label: Saar: A Claude.ai token and cost meter that runs entirely in the browser. On the Chrome Web Store. Pipeline: claude.ai to SSE intercept to tokenizer to overlay. 1,808 Vitest tests, 63 files; No backend data stays in browser.
